goal: Prevent external network observers from correlating I2P session creation with outbound connection timing
Improves privacy for nodes making outbound I2P connections without listening mode
reviewability: Needs a rebase and the author has been silent for over six months
agreement: Concept support for decoupling session creation from use to strengthen anonymity (zzzi2p)
Early objections over resource waste from multiple standby sessions were resolved by keeping just one
Nonblocking suggestion to refine when sessions are pre-created remains open (jonatack)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes a timing correlation leak that weakens privacy for outbound I2P connections
The privacy benefit is real for non-listening I2P users, but the timing leak is reasonably deferrable
